title: Hearty German Green Beans Salad
description: A fresh, juicy green bean salad with caramelized beans, tangy mustard dressing, and nutty crunch that feels like a nostalgic German comfort dish.
instructions: Trim the ends of the green beans and rinse them well.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the green beans to the skillet, stirring to coat in oil and garlic.
Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans are crisp‑tender and lightly caramelized.
Remove the skillet from heat and let the beans cool slightly.
Whisk together the dijon mustard, lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, dill, parsley, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Toss the caramelized beans with the dressing until evenly coated.
Sprinkle toasted walnuts over the salad for added crunch.
Serve the salad warm or at room temperature, garnishing with extra dill if desired.
